visualCharacteristics.layout: FILTERS toggle + Sort control + faceted checkbox panel above a responsive result-card grid, with a Load more button
visualCharacteristics.cardStructure: optional image + content-type label + title + 'Read more' link on a light-grey clickable tile
visualCharacteristics.controls: Filters toggle, Sort (Newest/Oldest/Title A–Z/Z–A), Show All (clear), Apply Filter, Load more

contentPattern: The author picks a parent page; the block lists all descendant pages from /query-index.json as tiles. Facets are built from indexed page metadata (content-type, industry, capability, partner, country); sorting uses lastModified and title. Filtering, sorting, and pagination are client-side.
usage: 'Find something specific' faceted content/case-study/blog archives driven by a parent page's descendants. Reusable across the site.
